notes.title: Patch 1.1
notes.content:
Changes in patch 1.1:
- Fixed bug with cave near wandering merchants
- Fixed animation for the golem
- Fixed bug with save
- Fixed bug with music
- Fixed a bug with the name of Aivars
- Fixed a bug when, after death, it was thrown back several levels
- Fixed bug with going beyond textures in the cave
- Partially fixed bug with getting stuck in objects
